prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that on June 14th you were observed using the metric system. Respond to the committee.
response:
*adjusts tie, leans into microphone*

Mr. Chairman, distinguished members of the committee—I come before you today as a patriot and a lover of freedom, and I categorically deny the scurrilous accusation that I willingly employed the metric system at any cookout, backyard or otherwise.

Let me be clear. On June 14th, I was grilling in accordance with the sacred traditions of this great nation. My burgers were sized in *hand-widths*. My propane was measured in *gut feeling*. And my grill temperature? Estimated by holding my palm over the grate until I could no longer stand it—the God-given "one-Mississippi" method passed down through generations.

Now, the committee alleges that I referred to a "two-liter" of soda.

*grips table*

I ask you—was *I* the one who put it in liters? No sir. That was Big Soda. That was a foreign conspiracy foisted upon the American consumer decades ago while good men slept. I merely *purchased* the beverage. Show me the man who sells a *half-gallon* of cola and I'll show you a true American, but he does not exist, because THEY got to the bottling plants.

As for the 5K fun run I attended that morning—I ran it in *football fields*, roughly 54.68 of them, and I resent the implication otherwise.

I have here a signed affidavit stating that my potato salad recipe uses *cups*, *sticks* of butter, and a *pinch*. I yield the rest of my time and I ask that the record reflect I brought my own charcoal.

*sits back down, salutes a nearby flag cake*
